title: "Code Map and Remaining Gaps"
description: "Where acquisition, evidence preparation, inference, scoring, and reporting live—and what is still missing."
---

::: {.lead}
The repository has reusable acquisition and benchmark seams, four supported
project commands, isolated model-family adapters, and several bespoke research
workflows. For a newcomer, **`vqa-frozen30` is the most complete end-to-end
workflow**; `vqa-gate` currently exposes preflight only, and there is no general
`vqa-score` command.
:::

Use [Start Here · Report page](index.{{< meta report-ext >}}) to choose a baseline and
[Research Themes · Report page](experiment-ledger.{{< meta report-ext >}}) to understand why
it was chosen.

::: {.callout-note title="How links in this report work"}
**Evidence of record · Evidence report · GitHub** links use the immutable
repository snapshot `814e55429f6dd1dc8570bc08f1dad849f74e36a1`.
**Current code · Source code · GitHub** links use `main` because those
implementation paths can evolve. **Issue/PR history · GitHub** links preserve
the project history. **Report page** links stay inside this report. GitHub links
require repository access until public release.
:::

## System pipeline

```{mermaid}
%%| label: fig-system-pipeline
%%| fig-cap: "The repository pipeline from source-video acquisition through sanitized reports."
%%| fig-alt: "Top-to-bottom pipeline. Acquisition passes local media into label-blind evidence preparation. Prepared requests go to isolated model-family inference. Frozen predictions move across a label boundary into scoring. Only sanitized aggregate findings are committed to reports."
flowchart TD
  accTitle: Project system pipeline
  accDescr: Acquisition feeds evidence preparation, inference, scoring after predictions freeze, and sanitized aggregate reports.
  A[Acquisition<br/>resumable local media] --> P[Evidence preparation<br/>frames, manifests, requests]
  P --> I[Inference<br/>isolated family adapters]
  I --> S[Scoring<br/>labels joined after freeze]
  S --> R[Reports<br/>sanitized aggregates]
```

::: {.content-visible when-format="gfm"}
**Figure caption:** The repository pipeline from source-video acquisition through
sanitized reports.
:::

| Stage | Main tracked code · Current code · Source code · GitHub | Boundary |
|---|---|---|
| Acquisition | [`youtube_dataset.py` · Current code · Source code · GitHub][youtube-module], [`vqa_download.py` · Current code · Source code · GitHub][download-module] | Media and runtime state stay local and ignored. |
| Evidence preparation | [`vqa_benchmark.py` · Current code · Source code · GitHub][benchmark-module], [`vqa_gate.py` · Current code · Source code · GitHub][gate-module], tracked configs | Questions and evidence are bound without reference labels in inference requests. |
| Inference | family runners plus [`vqa_frozen30_workflow.py` · Current code · Source code · GitHub][frozen-workflow] | Heavy model runtimes are isolated; request/result identity is checked. |
| Scoring | [`vqa_evaluation.py` · Current code · Source code · GitHub][evaluation-module] and experiment-specific scoring modules | Labels are joined only after predictions are frozen. |
| Reports | `docs/experiments/`, `reports/trecvid_vqa_2026/`, and these status pages | Commit sanitized summaries, never private runtime artifacts. |

The arrow sequence is operational, not a promise of a single universal
command. Only frozen-30 currently packages preparation, guarded execution,
resume/status, and scoring into one supported workflow.

## Trace the synthetic example to code {#synthetic-code-trace}

The [worked example · Report page](worked-example.{{< meta report-ext >}}) is a deliberately
invented explanation: no video was downloaded, no model ran, and no benchmark
row was written. The crosswalk below asks a narrower question: **if a real,
authorized row followed the same shape, which repository seam would own each
stage?** It does not convert the synthetic answer into executed evidence.

::: {.callout-warning title="Do not copy the stateful or expensive commands casually"}
`vqa-download` can download media and mutate ignored local runtime state.
`vqa-frozen30 run-whisper` and `vqa-frozen30 run CONDITION` can launch expensive
GPU inference. Inspect `status`/`--help`, confirm dataset authorization and the
frozen protocol, and obtain any required run authorization before using them.
The commands below are a code-path map, not a walkthrough to execute now.
:::

| Stage in the teaching trace | Exact reusable CLI or module | What really happened in the synthetic page |
|---|---|---|
| **1. Acquisition** | Reusable CLIs: `uv run vqa-download …` (TRECVID adapter) and `uv run youtube-dataset-download …` (generic engine); modules: [`vqa_download.py` · Current code · Source code · GitHub][download-module] and [`youtube_dataset.py` · Current code · Source code · GitHub][youtube-module]. | **Bespoke/missing execution:** the 22-second clip and scene notes were invented, so neither acquisition CLI ran and no media exists. |
| **2. Evidence preparation** | Reusable frozen workflow: `uv run vqa-frozen30 prepare`; reusable frame builder: `build_frame_evidence()` in [`vqa_benchmark.py` · Current code · Source code · GitHub][benchmark-module]. Transcript binding, when separately authorized evidence exists, is `uv run vqa-frozen30 build-transcript-requests`. | **Bespoke explanation:** twelve timestamps and one ASR line were authored for teaching; no frames, audio, cache, manifest, or request artifact was produced. |
| **3. Route** | **Missing general seam:** no versioned label-blind question router CLI/module exists. `build_transcript_requests()` in [`vqa_frozen30_workflow.py` · Current code · Source code · GitHub][frozen-workflow] reuses accepted ASR quality status, but it does not implement the proposed lexical-speech question classifier. | The route string `lexical_speech → request ASR → quality accepted` is an explanatory project-authored decision, not a router output. |
| **4. Inference** | Supported orchestrator: `uv run vqa-frozen30 run CONDITION`; isolated current adapter for the illustrated Qwen family: `python -m trec_video_2026.vqa_transformers_runner`, invoked by the workflow rather than as a separate supported project CLI. | **Bespoke/missing execution:** `green tea` was invented. No model, container, runner request, or result existed. |
| **5. Freeze** | No standalone freeze CLI. The reusable workflow validates and appends attempts through `append_attempt_rows()` and `validate_frozen_attempt()` in [`vqa_frozen30.py` · Current code · Source code · GitHub][frozen-controls]; `freeze_selected_predictions()` in [`vqa_frozen30_workflow.py` · Current code · Source code · GitHub][frozen-workflow] selects validated saved rows. | “Frozen prediction” describes the narrated label boundary only; there is no append-only attempt row, hash, or run identifier. |
| **6. Score** | Workflow CLI: `uv run vqa-frozen30 score`; reusable join-and-score module: `evaluate_saved_predictions()` in [`vqa_evaluation.py` · Current code · Source code · GitHub][evaluation-module]. There is no general `vqa-score` CLI. | Exact match and token F1 of `1.0` were explanatory arithmetic on invented strings, not benchmark metrics. |
| **7. Report** | **Bespoke/missing general CLI:** `vqa-frozen30 score` writes scored artifacts, but publication remains a manual, sanitized reporting step into tracked evidence pages. No reusable report generator promotes a run automatically. | This local worked-example page reports teaching content only and is not an evidence-of-record benchmark report. |

For an executed benchmark row, the minimum distinguishing evidence would be a
frozen run/condition identity, validated request and attempt records, artifact
hashes, runtime attestations, and post-freeze scoring provenance. The synthetic
page explicitly records that all of those are absent.

## Supported commands {#supported-commands}

The four installed project scripts are declared in
[`pyproject.toml` · Current code · Source code · GitHub][pyproject].
After `uv sync`, inspect them with `uv run <command> --help`; do not launch a
large download or GPU run merely to explore the code.

| Command | Role | What a newcomer should know |
|---|---|---|
| `youtube-dataset-download` | Generic YouTube-ID/watch-URL acquisition | Reusable engine with `prepare`, `run`, `start`, and read-only `status` commands for a configured YouTube dataset. |
| `vqa-download` | TRECVID-specific acquisition adapter | Supplies repository-specific paths and operational defaults around the generic engine; commands can mutate ignored local runtime state. |
| `vqa-gate` | Small compatibility-gate entry point | Its public CLI exposes **`preflight` only**. The completed family runs used tested Python seams and adapters rather than a general one-command gate. |
| `vqa-frozen30` | Frozen-30 benchmark workflow | The most complete workflow: CPU preparation, read-only status, Whisper generation, transcript request binding, explicit condition authorization/run, resume controls, and scoring. |

There is **no general `vqa-score` CLI**. General scoring primitives live in
[`vqa_evaluation.py` · Current code · Source code · GitHub][evaluation-module]; frozen-30 exposes its own `score`
action, and later experiments have purpose-built scoring modules or scripts.

## Code layers

| Layer | Representative paths · Current code · Source code · GitHub | Intended reuse |
|---|---|---|
| Supported CLIs | `youtube_dataset.py`, `vqa_download.py`, `vqa_gate.py`, `vqa_frozen30_workflow.py` | Stable user entry points declared by `pyproject.toml`. |
| Reusable modules | [`vqa_benchmark.py` · Current code · Source code · GitHub][benchmark-module], [`vqa_frozen30.py` · Current code · Source code · GitHub][frozen-controls], [`vqa_evaluation.py` · Current code · Source code · GitHub][evaluation-module], [`vqa_models.py` · Current code · Source code · GitHub][model-module] | Evidence construction, manifests, fail-closed resume controls, evaluation, and shared prompt behavior. |
| Specialist adapters | [`vqa_transformers_runner.py` · Current code · Source code · GitHub][transformers-runner], [`vqa_specialist_runner.py` · Current code · Source code · GitHub][specialist-runner], [`vqa_omni_runner.py` · Current code · Source code · GitHub][omni-runner], [`vqa_whisper.py` · Current code · Source code · GitHub][whisper-runner], [`vqa_audio_runner.py` · Current code · Source code · GitHub][audio-runner], [`vqa_seamless.py` · Current code · Source code · GitHub][seamless-runner] | Isolated `python -m trec_video_2026.<module>` request/result adapters for pinned model families or modalities; they are not separate project scripts. |
| Bespoke experiment workflows | [`vqa_experiments/` · Current code · Source code · GitHub][experiments-package] and `scripts/` experiment helpers | Frozen contracts, transport, scoring, and collection for a specific research question; reuse only after reading that experiment's report and limitations. |

The useful architectural split is between orchestration and adapters:
host-side code freezes requests and validates provenance, while model-family
runners import heavy dependencies only inside their pinned execution runtime.

## Remaining gaps

These are issue **seeds**, not newly created GitHub issues. Validate and scope
them before implementation.

### Documentation seeds

- Add one safe, copy-paste walkthrough from `uv sync` through a read-only
  preflight/status inspection, without assuming dataset access.
- Document which experiment-specific modules are reusable contracts versus
  frozen historical workflows.
- Keep a small claim-to-report-to-code crosswalk as new experiments supersede
  older recommendations.
- Document the separate Quarto source, GitHub-readable Markdown, and
  self-contained HTML update procedure after the first render is reviewed.

### Engineering seeds

- Extend `vqa-gate` beyond `preflight` only if one general prepare/run/report
  contract can preserve the existing label and provenance boundaries.
- Decide whether a general `vqa-score` CLI is valuable, or whether scoring
  should remain owned by frozen workflows; do not silently expose labels to
  inference-side code.
- Consolidate the common request/result contract across Transformers,
  specialist, audio, and omni adapters without erasing required family-specific
  attestations.
- Turn the recommended question/evidence routing policy into a label-blind,
  versioned configuration with explicit fallback and non-regression gates.
- Define a cheap representative end-to-end smoke path before any larger local
  or rented-GPU run.

### Research directions

Exact hypotheses, smallest valid panels, controls, integrity safeguards, and
decision rules live on the six theme pages rather than being duplicated here:

- [Experiment integrity and evaluation](research-integrity.{{< meta report-ext >}})
- [Visual and temporal evidence](research-visual-evidence.{{< meta report-ext >}})
- [Speech and transcript evidence](research-speech-transcripts.{{< meta report-ext >}})
- [Native audio and sound](research-native-audio.{{< meta report-ext >}})
- [Models and adaptation](research-models.{{< meta report-ext >}})
- [Routing, fusion, and answer selection](research-routing.{{< meta report-ext >}})

The current safe next action is therefore determined by the question: use
[Research Themes · Report page](experiment-ledger.{{< meta report-ext >}}) for a research
decision, or begin at the supported-command table above for a code change.
